question: How is the region below Meru around Jambu divided in detail and in summary?
premises: The region below Meru around Jambu has been described.
In detailed reckoning it can be divided into seventeen parts.
In summary it is divided into nine parts.
inference: The Jambu region below Meru admits a seventeenfold detailed division and a ninefold summary division.
uncertainties: The basis for the seventeenfold detailed division is not spelled out in this verse.
plain_english: Thus the region below Meru around Jambu, when described in detail, is divided into seventeen parts, but in summary into nine.
